title: Mastectomy
what: The surgeon removes the whole breast. Often some lymph nodes under the arm are removed too.
why: Most often for breast cancer. Sometimes to prevent cancer in women with a high inherited risk.
duration: surgery usually takes 1.5 to 3 hours, with a few days in hospital
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will say what to stop and when
Allergies to medicines, latex, or iodine
Heart or lung disease, or diabetes
If you want breast reconstruction. Sometimes it is done at the same time
What worries you. You can ask to see a psychologist

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, and sometimes a GP checkup. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthetist
prepare.text: Before surgery, an anesthetist will talk with you. Tell them about your health and medicines.

prepare.title: Food and water
prepare.text: Usually no food from the night before and no drinks for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Talk it through
prepare.text: Ask your surgeon in advance about drains, reconstruction, and a breast form. It helps you feel calmer.

steps: You change, and an IV line is placed
The surgeon removes the breast and, if needed, lymph nodes
A thin tube called a drain is placed to let fluid out
The wound is stitched, and a dressing is applied
feel: Pain and tightness in the chest and under the arm. You will get painkillers
Numb skin on the chest and upper arm. It often lasts a long time
It is hard and emotional. Support from loved ones and a psychologist helps
after: The drain usually comes out after a few days, depending on the amount of fluid
Arm exercises start on your doctor's plan
On the arm on the surgery side, avoid cuts and tight cuffs. Your doctor will explain
The lab results will guide further treatment
A temporary, then a permanent breast form can be fitted
red_flags: A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), or redness and pus from the wound
Fluid has built up under the skin, and the area is very swollen
The arm on the surgery side is very swollen
Calf pain, shortness of breath, or chest pain: call emergency services

faq.a: Yes. Sometimes right away, sometimes later. Discuss the options with your surgeon.
Because lymph nodes were removed. Exercises and caring for the arm lower the risk.

reminders.text: Surgery tomorrow. Bring your test results and button-up clothes. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
